summary: npm package ships only an obfuscated HTML page impersonating a Cloudflare Turnstile challenge
details: The tarball contains a single file, index.html, declared as the package's main entry in package.json. The HTML impersonates a Cloudflare Turnstile challenge page and embeds a heavily obfuscated inline script using hex-renamed identifiers, a string-array dispatcher, and dynamically reconstructed *.cloudflare.com URL fragments. package.json declares no lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) and main points at an HTML file rather than JavaScript, so npm install and require() of this package do not execute the embedded script. Any harm from the obfuscated content would require the HTML to be opened in a browser, which is outside the installer-side threat surface. The package has no legitimate library behavior and appears to exist to distribute the phishing-shaped HTML page via the npm registry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
